remarks: Beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 2-full-bath apartment at 64 Soundview Avenue in Stamford. This move-in-ready unit has been completely updated from wall to wall with fresh modern finishes throughout. The apartment features new flooring, fresh paint, recessed lighting, new windows, updated fixtures, and a stylish kitchen with new cabinetry, countertops, backsplash, and appliances. Both full bathrooms have been fully renovated with clean, contemporary finishes, offering added comfort and convenience. With three bedrooms, two full baths, and a bright, refreshed layout, this apartment is ready for immediate occupancy. Enjoy the feel of a brand-new space in a convenient Stamford location.
